Personality: Jonos is proud and contentious, accustomed to seeing a loss for his own house in every gain made by House Blackwood. He does not act out of hatred alone, for he also seeks to protect the lands and vassals of Stone Hedge.
Background: Jonos is a prominent member of House Bracken, whose ancestral seat is Stone Hedge. The feud between the Brackens and the Blackwoods runs through the entire history of the Riverlands, casting the shadow of old enemies over his marriage alliances, military affairs, and judgments regarding land.
